name: Gale Dart
notes: Always available on the Bolt button. Fastest bolt of the four schools (Lab projectile x1.35; damage x0.85 of Ember Dart).

name: Shear
notes: Two blades that converge on the aim point. Reuses the Twin Tides shape.

name: Slipstream
notes: Mobility without stamina. The AI's main Momentum source. Reuses the Cinder Step dash without the trail.

name: Veering Bolt
shape: curving projectile 16 m/s entering 60 deg off the line of sight
notes: The arc is drawn during the cast. Comes in from the flank so the seated player must read where it lands. New shape: a fixed-curvature arc.

name: Downdraft
shape: ground circle r 2.5 m at a point
notes: A column of air slams a pad. Reuses the Pyre Circle shape at a smaller radius.

name: Air Form
notes: Defence D (SCHOOL-DEFENCES.md): evade 60 % of physical and 30 % of magic hits; unblockables are not evaded. Needs Momentum 40 or more.

name: Squall
shape: four projectiles 14 m/s released 0.25 s apart
notes: A rhythm to read: each orb has its own activation id so each can be perfected. New shape: a staggered volley.

name: Eye of the Storm
notes: Absorb drain x1.5 while it lasts. The gamble (the Furnace Heart pattern).

name: Tempest Lance
notes: The signature. The line is drawn to the target for 1.2 s; blink off the line. Caster is rooted for the cast and can be interrupted. Reuses the Brand Lance line shape as unblockable.

name: Cyclone
notes: Each tick has its own activation id. Reuses the Brand Wrath channel.
